evidenceLimits: Complete relevant families, not the complete dictionary. Omission does not prove absence. Selected senses are non-exhaustive and not independent level assignments. Mapping/source notes are author assertions to assess, not reviewer findings.

rows.mappingNote: Exact spelling/reading and entry; altitude/height plus high degree, advanced level or sophistication.
rows.sourceNote: Noun altitude distinguished from descriptive na/no and ni uses. Strong is degree-dependent, not a claim of physical strength in every context.

rows.mappingNote: Exact spelling/reading and entry; high class or grade.
rows.sourceNote: Na/no and compound uses; higher education and senior high school compounds have separately verified complete families. High grade is not automatically luxury or price.

rows.mappingNote: Exact spelling/reading and entry; combination, union, joining or incorporation.
rows.sourceNote: Joint events do not require legal corporate merger, but incorporation/merger remains positively recognized. Shared/joint modification and mathematical congruence are additional teaching.

rows.mappingNote: Exact spelling/reading and entry; junior colleague/student and younger people.
rows.sourceNote: Shared-setting entry/experience and relevant age uses are acknowledged. No universal younger-only, age-impossible or management-subordinate equivalence; missing 輩 stays in metadata.

rows.mappingNote: Exact spelling/reading and entry; official public announcement or proclamation.
rows.sourceNote: Transitive suru with information as object; public agencies and companies both supported. Official is not interpreted as government-only or proof of truth.

rows.mappingNote: Exact spelling/reading and entry; mineral.
rows.sourceNote: Rare spelling 礦物 explicitly recognized without frequency inference. Mineral/ore overlap retained rather than teaching a rigid partition from 鉱石.

rows.mappingNote: Exact spelling/reading and entry; official or public business/duties.
rows.sourceNote: Noun with 公務で/公務を行う; not an assumed suru verb, every public transaction, private errand or the employee as a person.

rows.mappingNote: Exact spelling/reading and entry; listed item, heading, category or clause.
rows.sourceNote: Organized-unit account qualifies broad item and clause glosses. Dictionary headword/entry is additional sense 2. Missing 項 stays in metadata.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source spelling/reading and entry retained for こうよう autumn coloring/leaves; raw maple gloss separately accounted for under もみじ.
rows.sourceNote: Current pinned 1578780 has こうよう autumn colors, not maple. Additional complete family 2857870 positively supports 紅葉/もみじ maple and foliage. Both are explicitly taught; historical compiler intent is not recovered. Daijisen's multi-heading container must not attach もみじ senses to こうよう.
rows.identityNote: Source gloss/reading mismatch: preserve raw '(Japanese) maple' and こうよう independently. The maple meaning is taught only with separately sourced もみじ; no fabricated maple sense is assigned to 1578780 or constituent character readings.

rows.mappingNote: Exact spelling/reading and noun entry; rationality, with the raw rational adjective qualified through 合理的.
rows.sourceNote: 合理 is a noun, not an assumed plain na-adjective. Separate 1285380:1 supports 合理的な/に. Additional derivative teaching does not independently acquire N2.

rows.mappingNote: Exact spelling/reading and entry; social/cultural exchange or interaction, and alternating current.
rows.sourceNote: Source intercourse is qualified as social dealings/communication. Intransitive suru belongs to the social sense; electrical AC is separately a noun, contrasted with 直流.

rows.mappingNote: Exact spelling/reading and entry; river confluence and people/groups/traffic joining.
rows.sourceNote: Intransitive suru with AがBに and 人と frames. Linking up does not necessarily mean a first introduction or permanent legal merger.

rows.mappingNote: Exact spelling/reading and entry; effect, efficacy, validity or potency.
rows.sourceNote: Noun for power to produce an effect or force/validity; particle frames and difference from effective adjective/verb taught without a rigid efficacy-versus-effect wall.

rows.mappingNote: Reuse existing 越える article: exact source alias 超える/こえる and exceeding sense already explicitly taught with an example.
rows.sourceNote: Primary 越える, reading, title, kanji [越], exclusions and easier jlpt3 preserved. Narrow addition substantively links the 超 alternative component; reciprocal 超 examples link alias label to stable 越える ID.
rows.identityNote: Same-entry identity alone is insufficient: actual body already teaches 超える and its こえる reading, exceeding construction and ichidan forms. Reuse is alias coverage, not a new primary-form article or primary-form reciprocal pair.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source kana spelling/reading and entry; explicit non-exhaustive route/course-of-study selection for broad course gloss.
rows.sourceNote: Bare source course does not recover a unique historical sense. Additional individual meal course, full-course meal and offered service plan are taught and separately indexed. Sports lane, policy/path and baseball pitch uses not exhaustively taught or independently assigned N2.
rows.identityNote: Explicit practical sense selection, not a claim that every dictionary sense is part of the source's intended N2 assignment.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source kana spelling/reading and entry; musical chorus.
rows.sourceNote: Actual Daijisen choral singing, piece and group scope inspected. Song refrain/hook is distinguished through positively recorded サビ, not an unlimited denial of every other chorus use.

rows.mappingNote: Exact spelling/reading and entry; transitive godan burn/scorch/singe/char.
rows.sourceNote: Literal scorching, direct object を and godan forms; intransitive 焦げる contrast. Burning sense of 焼く considered beyond its cooking title. Missing 焦 stays in metadata.

rows.mappingNote: Exact spelling/reading and entry; king/queen/monarch/sovereign.
rows.sourceNote: King is positively taught without a universal male-only assertion; sovereign title depends on country. Legal Crown/throne sense 2 is outside selected practical scope.

rows.mappingNote: Exact spelling/reading and entry; personal nationality or citizenship.
rows.sourceNote: Status distinguished from people, residence, origin and ethnicity. Ship/aircraft national registration is additional sense 2, not passenger citizenship or every registration.

rows.mappingNote: Exact spelling/reading and entry; nationally established/run institution.
rows.sourceNote: Noun/no modifier and compound uses; usual 国立/公立/私立 classification qualified by 公立's positively recorded broader public-versus-private use. Separate place-name くにたち not assigned to institution examples.

quizGuardRationale: Direct symmetric nontransitive guards address actual labels/ordinary senses; they do not assert unrestricted Japanese synonymy or infer cliques from topic or spelling. Baseline exclusions remain unchanged.

高度 and 高等 directly protect high-class/grade and general high/quality answers; 高度 also protects generic height on 背 and positively recorded strong/potent descriptions on 強い/強力. Person-qualified 身長 is not made an altitude synonym. Existing 高級 guards do not protect any third pair transitively.

合同 directly protects joining/combination/cooperation/union and mathematical agreement/equality wording. 節's anatomical joint is an English-label ambiguity only, not a mathematical/body identity. 合同/合流 is independently supported by union/joining senses; 合同 does not automatically mean every organization or a permanent corporate merger.
後輩/先輩 remain useful contrasting relationships, not synonyms or exclusions merely because paired.

公表 protects announcement/notification/report and broad publication labels, including 広告's ordinary announcement sense. Book issuing and public disclosure remain distinct constructions; no assertion that every publication is 公表.
鉱物/鉱石 has positive mineral overlap; rocks, metals and gemstones are related material categories, not an automatic clique.
公務 protects broad work and administrative-work wording, not 公務員's person label or every private errand.

項目 protects ordinary item/heading/category/classification meanings and underqualified item/article labels. 節's ふし card does not teach a numbered text clause; no clause sense is transferred to that primary reading.
紅葉/葉 protects the broad leaf/foliage answer for physically colored leaves. Autumn as a season and maple as a particular tree are not inferred to be identical to every autumn leaf.
合理 rationality is distinguished from 理由's reason/grounds and a private motive. The shared English reason alone does not convert 理由 into a faculty-of-reason sense.

交流 protects exchange, social dealings and generic current wording on 流れ; currency conversion is not automatically cultural exchange. 交流/合流 separately protects their positive coming-together/joining wording without saying every interaction merges a group.
合流 protects union/joining, coming together and actual meet/gather/link-up/flow wording. Its guard through 合同 does not protect any other pair transitively.

効力 protects effectiveness/validity and actual effect/power/capability senses on 効果/有効/効く/影響/力/能力. Noun-versus-verb differences alone do not make English answers unique; the article distinguishes force/capacity from an arbitrary outcome.

コース protects route/way, educational course/class/lesson, generic course/flow, meal/dish/course and plan/package/option labels with each direct pair assessed. 皿 positively has serving/course as well as plate; not merely a topic association. Meal and service senses do not imply every individual plate or future appointment is a コース.
コーラス has no exclusion based solely on its similarity to コース; missing 合唱/合唱団 articles are not fabricated.
焦がす protects burn meanings, including 焼く beyond its bake/grill title, and intransitive burn labels on 焼ける/燃える. Particle and scorching/combustion distinctions remain taught.
国王 protects 王/王様 and positively recorded queen on 女王. 国籍 names a status, not 国民/市民 people; no automatic exclusion from shared citizenship subject matter.
国立 protects 公立's positively broad public-institution sense and 公共's public label, without discarding the normal three-way institutional classification.
sourceAccessLimits: Nineteen new articles plus reused 越える cover N2:522-N2:541; community membership is not an official modern syllabus.
Four new primary-form reciprocal N2 pairs: 鉱/鉱物, 紅/紅葉, 効/効力, 籍/国籍. Separate 超/越える alias-reading pair uses 超える label with こえる, not a new primary-form pair.
Missing primary components 輩, 項 and 焦 remain written metadata. Every existing primary component is substantively linked; no new kanji/stroke article fabricated.
紅葉 raw source reading, entry and '(1) (Japanese) maple' gloss remain intact. Current families positively separate こうよう/autumn colors and もみじ/maple; historical compiler intent is not recovered.
Additional senses and 合理的 derivative do not independently acquire N2 assignments. コース practical selection does not claim to recover the one historical meaning of the raw course gloss.

越える identity/primary reading/title/[越]/exclusions/jlpt3 remain unchanged. Only an alternative-component explanation/link is added; existing alias example and both principal senses already supplied actual reuse coverage.
All baseline identities/readings/titles/arrays/exclusions and easier levels preserved; no baseline exclusion exception added.

Original examples are pedagogical, not corpus attestations or native-speaker certification. Dictionary recognition does not establish measured frequency. Author public-entry receipts are not independent reviewer retrieval.
Full copyrighted lexical bodies remain private; public observations are concise original paraphrases and URLs/hashes.
Initial reviewer derivative removes only quizGuardRationale; retained mappings and source notes are author assertions for assessment.

correctionEvidence.provenance: Append-only follow-up evidence. Original families, rows, labels, receipts and author rationale remain unchanged.
